name: Chicken, Pepper & Cucumber Chopped Salad
method: Heat the oven to 180C (160C fan). Season the chicken, put it on a baking tray and bake for 25 minutes until cooked through, then leave to cool, as this salad is not served warm.
Chop the chicken, pepper, cucumber, coriander and nuts into even pieces and mix in a bowl.
Dress with the vinegar and oil and toss vigorously.
Serve with a spoonful of cottage cheese on each portion.
